description: This file implements trust store management for NSS certificates within Chromium, including trust evaluation, issuer retrieval, and trust record handling, with specific focus on NSS trust settings, slot filtering, and trust object parsing.

classes.name: TrustStoreNSS::ResultDebugData
classes.description: Holds debug data related to trust store operations, including trust settings and slot filtering.

classes.name: TrustStoreNSS::ListCertsResult
classes.description: Represents a certificate and its associated trust level in trust store listing operations.

methods.name: TrustStoreNSS::Get
methods.description: Retrieves trust information for a given certificate, considering system trust settings.

methods.name: TrustStoreNSS::ListCertsIgnoringNSSRoots
methods.description: Lists all certificates excluding NSS roots, with their trust levels.

methods.name: TrustStoreNSS::GetTrust
methods.description: Determines trust for a certificate, with optional debug data.

methods.name: TrustStoreNSS::GetTrustIgnoringSystemTrust
methods.description: Determines trust for a certificate ignoring system trust settings, with internal logic for NSS trust records.

methods.name: TrustStoreNSS::GetTrustForNSSTrust
methods.description: Converts NSS CERTCertTrust flags into internal trust representations.

methods.name: TrustStoreNSS::IsCertAllowedForTrust
methods.description: Checks if a certificate is allowed for trust evaluation based on slot and trust settings.
